description: Eva returns as Camilo learns Luisa is pregnant, forcing him to confront impending fatherhood just as he hopes to repair his relationship with Eva. During the group's final school year in 1977, the pregnancy divides families and classmates, student politics and new romances test the friends, and Ana and José's marriage begins to fracture. Camilo's attempt to be responsible without losing Eva becomes the central conflict as the group starts making decisions that will follow them beyond school.

s02e01.description: Eva returns to Bogotá just as Camilo is forced to confront Luisa's pregnancy, and she distances herself from him after learning how it happened. Luisa hides at Eva's house and considers an illegal abortion, but at the clinic she changes her mind and decides to continue the pregnancy.

s02e02.description: Martín learns that Luisa is pregnant and attacks Camilo, while the adults pressure the teenagers toward a marriage neither of them wants. Ana refuses to treat pregnancy as a reason to sacrifice Luisa's future and throws José out during their argument, while the school refuses to readmit Luisa and turns the conflict into a wider debate over girls' rights.

s02e03.description: Eva organizes a student strike demanding that Luisa be allowed back at José María Root, and Martín eventually reconciles with Camilo. A parent-teacher vote still blocks Luisa's return, but Camilo publishes an article challenging the decision and secures both her readmission and his own first real opportunity as a reporter.

s02e04.description: The friends travel through Melgar toward Bucaramanga and meet truck driver Antonio, whose sudden death leaves them responsible for returning his savings. In Bucaramanga they find Gustavo living with Natalia while concealing his sexuality; after the truth comes out, Gustavo chooses to rejoin the group, and Luisa grows closer to Rodrigo.

s02e05.description: A holiday in Cartagena gives Camilo a chance to work as a sports reporter, but jealousy over Eva's past and heavy drinking cause him to miss the assignment he was supposed to cover. Eva helps him salvage the article, while the group's Christmas exchange and Camilo's carefully chosen book for her expose how much of their relationship remains unresolved.

s02e06.description: A conservative sex-education class led by Tello provokes Eva into challenging what the school teaches about desire, contraception and women's choices. Camilo's newspaper work consumes more of his time as Luisa's pregnancy advances, and Rodrigo increasingly becomes the person accompanying and supporting her through the medical appointments.

s02e07.description: Eva helps remove Tello from the sex-education course and Rosario, a woman from José's past, takes over the class. Eva's former boyfriend Alfredo arrives from the United States intending to win her back, while Luisa tells Camilo that her feelings are shifting toward Rodrigo rather than the father of her child.

s02e08.description: Eva, Camilo and Alfredo take hallucinogenic mushrooms, and Eva finally tells Camilo that she became pregnant by Alfredo in the United States and had an abortion after he abandoned her. Rosario separately reveals that José fathered her daughter Janet, while Lucy's admission that she is attracted to women forces the Granados family to confront another subject they had avoided.

s02e09.description: Camilo's arguments about family and gender alienate Eva as he struggles to recognize how much of José's worldview he has absorbed. He meets Janet, his half-sister with Down syndrome, while José avoids the encounter; Álvaro's involvement in a robbery with the Acuña brothers then threatens the group's standing at school.

s02e10.description: José begins building a relationship with Janet while Eva creates a student council and runs against Quiñónez, only to lose after her opponents weaponize scandal and prejudice against her. As the school fight ends, Luisa goes into labor and gives birth to Antonia, permanently changing Camilo, Luisa and Rodrigo's responsibilities to one another.
